cases.scenario: The user explicitly requests a Meta-O Orca review of one full candidate SHA.
must: create exactly two independent vendor-diverse reviewers
settle only a complete same-SHA pair

cases.scenario: The user makes a generic review request outside the Meta-O lifecycle.
One reviewer is unavailable or reports a different candidate SHA.
must: report the exact unavailable or mismatched role
mustNot: deliver a singleton as a pair
